method: Decisions counted only when they reach the Python engine: both engines were constructed with enable_quick_eval=False, so no decision is bypassed. Ground truth per (game, pov) = PlayerState replay of the arena-written game log, can_act points whose trigger is not hora/ryukyoku/end_kyoku. Alignment of the live Rust feed to those points uses the env-gated MORTAL_EVT_DEBUG record (game slot, seat, kan flag, n, first/last type) which is written per evaluate() call in the same order as the react_batch argument list; every recorded sample is additionally content-checked by md5 of the token bytes.
